en.title: Japan eSIM with a Phone Number: Getting a Number as a Tourist
en.excerpt: Tourist SIMs in Japan are almost always data-only. How to get a phone number for your trip, why it helps with restaurants, ryokan and luggage forwarding, and how to pair it with cheap data.
en.metaTitle: Japan eSIM with a Phone Number: Calls, SMS and Data
en.metaDesc: Japan eSIM with a phone number: tourist SIMs in Japan are data-only. A global number that works in Japan, Korea and Hong Kong, plus cheap data. From $27.90 a week.
en.ogTitle: A Phone Number for Japan When Tourist SIMs Are Data-Only
en.ogDesc: Restaurants, ryokan and luggage services in Japan run on phone numbers. How to get one for your trip, and what it costs.

hi.title: फ़ोन नंबर वाला जापान eSIM: टूरिस्ट को नंबर कैसे मिले
